toc: yes
number-sections: "false"
df-print: banana
citations-hover: true
documentclass: myclass
format: htlm
title: My Talk: 2026
cache: banana
pdf-engine: PDFLATEX
---

Prose body. The six wrong values above — toc (bare non-boolean), number-sections
(quoted boolean), df-print (enum non-member), `format: htlm` (unknown output-format
NAME, a typo of `html`), cache (enum-with-boolean-members, off-list), pdf-engine
(enum WRONG CASE) — each render exit 1 under `quarto render` 1.7.33; the rest render
exit 0 and must never be flagged: `citations-hover: true` (valid boolean),
`documentclass: myclass` (OPEN string.completions), `title:` (free string). The
`format` NAME is validated against quarto's front-matter schema layer
(format-name validation plan §3.1) — extension/modifier/hidden/.lua names stay silent.
